description: Defines the RttStats class for storing RTT samples and calculating smoothed RTT and standard deviation, used in QUIC congestion control.

classes.name: quic::RttStats
classes.description: Class for tracking RTT samples, smoothed RTT, and standard deviation in QUIC.

classes.name: quic::RttStats::StandardDeviationCaculator
classes.description: Helper struct for calculating standard deviation using Welford's algorithm.

methods.name: UpdateRtt
methods.description: Updates RTT measurements based on new sample and acknowledgment delay.

methods.name: ExpireSmoothedMetrics
methods.description: Updates smoothed RTT and deviation metrics when RTT increases.

methods.name: OnConnectionMigration
methods.description: Resets RTT measurements on connection migration.

methods.name: set_initial_rtt
methods.description: Sets the initial RTT value, with a check for non-positive values.

methods.name: GetStandardOrMeanDeviation
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation if valid, otherwise the mean deviation.

methods.name: CloneFrom
methods.description: Copies RTT state from another RttStats instance.
